d:
Presenting the video song of Mere Ankhon Se Nikle Ansoo sung by Shreya Ghoshal & composed by Nadeem Saifi from the movie Ishq Forever.
'Ishq Forever' is a breezy musical rom com Bollywood film introducing Krishna and starring Lisa Ray, Ruhi Singh & Javed Jafferi.
The film 'ISHQ Forever' is Directed by debutante Sameer Sippy & Produced by Ajay Shah, Himanshu Gandhi & Shabeer Boxwala under their banner Friday Cine Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.
This film also marks the come back of music director Nadeem Saifi & Lyrics by Sameer Anjaan.
Arrangers/Programmers : Jackie Vanjari
